events.title: Release Date Announcement
events.summary: After almost three and a half years since the project began in a very different form, Attack of the Astrals is set to release on November 26th! Watch the release date trailer above, which also introduces the final 3 champions in the full game at release: the Bombard, the Oracle and the Architect! The BombardBombard is a knight who spawns explosive minions and destroys obstacles. He is strongest on crowded maps, as his attack is amplified by each unit adjacent to his targets. events.title: The Champion Update (0.9.5)
events.summary: The Champion Update is a comprehensive refinement of the game to address the biggest items of feedback from the playtest:Replay value needs investmentThe Astral ambush every battle is not funThe game is punishing, especially for new playersPlaytime metrics back this up. events.title: The Challenger Update (0.9.4)
events.summary: The Challenger Update is huge! We've expanded the range of strategies each run, introducing difficulty levels and scaling Scroll rewards. Take it easy with a lower difficulty, or fight flawlessly for a high EXP score and powerful Scrolls, all while listening to new regional music composed by Jared Farney.Watch the video overview:Earn Experience in BattleYou now start at Level I each run and earn experience each battle. events.summary: We’re excited to announce that we’ve opened up the first public playtest of Attack of the Astrals to all players! It’s available on all PC platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux, and Steam Deck.
